name: Cut It
summary: Open-source URL shortener web app with customizable short links, built with Next.js and shadcn/ui.
description: Cut It is a free open-source tool for generating short links: shorten long URLs, customize the generated links, and manage them from a user-friendly interface. Built on the Next.js App Router with Drizzle ORM, Turso and NextAuth; link analytics are listed as coming soon. Inspired by Dub.
contains: shortens long URLs; short links are customizable
stack: Next.js, Drizzle, Turso, NextAuth, Upstash Redis, Tailwind CSS, shadcn/ui
